title: Conditions of Reservation: When a Hotel Rate Plan May Be Sold
content:
A rate plan of the Hotel Rate Plans range may only be sold when the arrival date is at least its advance-purchase distance away, when the stay length falls between its minimum and maximum nights, when the arrival falls inside its booking window, and when the number of rooms is at or below its ceiling. Each of those four limits is the figure contracted against the plan booked. A request at or above the rate plan's group threshold is not taken under these conditions and is passed to the group desk.

**The standing of a reservation before the property answers.** The reservation is merely held until the property confirms it; an unconfirmed reservation binds nobody and is released without charge.

**Occupancy as declared.** The occupancy declared at booking is the occupancy the room is priced for, and children at or below the rate plan's free age limit are not counted as extra occupants.

**The agency's own charge.** The agency service fee is charged once per reservation at the moment the property confirms, and is not multiplied by the number of rooms. Where the guest elects to be charged in a currency other than the property's own, the rate plan's conversion markup is added and disclosed before the card is taken.

| Condition | Measured against | Result where it is not met |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Arrival at least the plan's advance-purchase distance away | The plan booked | The plan may not be sold |
| Stay length between the plan's minimum and maximum nights | The plan booked | The plan may not be sold |
| Arrival inside the plan's booking window | The plan booked | The plan may not be sold |
| Rooms at or below the plan's ceiling | The plan booked | The plan may not be sold |
| Rooms below the plan's group threshold | The plan booked | The booking passes to the group desk |
